# Outlines whose security gates report and do not block
# (.github/workflows/security-gates.yml).
#
# Every other chapter that fails a gate fails the job. These two Parts are
# outlines: each holds a README and no chapter, and their labs wait until the
# chapters are written. A failure under them is listed in the run summary and
# does not fail the job. Remove a line when the Part has chapters whose labs
# have run, and add the Part to .github/security-gates-enforced.txt in the
# same pull request.
#
# One path per line, relative to full-guide/. A directory covers everything
# under it.
